name: Workplace Shows
tagline: The job is the excuse. The coworkers are the point.
description: Professional setting comedies where the job is the excuse and the coworkers are the point. Incompetent bosses welcome.

questions.questionText: What is Dwight Schrute's official job title that he insists on using in The Office?
questions.funFact: The 'assistant TO the regional manager' vs 'assistant regional manager' distinction is corrected dozens of times throughout the series.

questions.questionText: What is the name of Dwight's family farm in The Office?
questions.funFact: Schrute Farms doubles as a bed & breakfast. Rainn Wilson said filming farm scenes was his favorite part of the show.

questions.questionText: What are both of Ron Swanson's ex-wives named in Parks and Recreation?
questions.funFact: Tammy 2 is played by Megan Mullally, who is Nick Offerman's real-life wife. Their on-screen hatred is the opposite of their real relationship.

questions.questionText: What is the name of Andy Dwyer's band in Parks and Recreation?
questions.funFact: The band changed names constantly — Scarecrow Boat, Punch Face Champions, Ninja Dick — but always settled back on Mouse Rat.

questions.questionText: What annual tradition do Tom and Donna celebrate in Parks and Recreation?
questions.funFact: 'Treat Yo' Self' became a real cultural phenomenon. October 13th is now celebrated as Treat Yo' Self Day by fans.

questions.questionText: What phrase does Chris Traeger enthusiastically say while pointing finger-guns in Parks and Rec?
questions.funFact: Rob Lowe was originally signed for a six-episode arc. His chemistry with the cast was so strong they made him a series regular.

questions.questionText: What was Chris Pratt's character Andy Dwyer originally meant to be on Parks and Rec?
questions.funFact: Pratt was only supposed to appear in Season 1. His improvised goofiness was so beloved they made Andy a permanent cast member.

questions.questionText: What is the fictional Indiana town where Parks and Recreation is set?
questions.funFact: Pawnee's rival city Eagleton is a running gag — it's the wealthy, snobbish town next door that Pawnee constantly feuds with.

questions.questionText: What is Liz Lemon's favorite snack food on 30 Rock?
questions.funFact: Tina Fey sang 'Working on my night cheese' to the tune of 'Night Moves.' It became one of the show's most quotable moments.

questions.questionText: Where is Kenneth Parcell originally from on 30 Rock?
questions.funFact: The show repeatedly hints Kenneth may be immortal. In the finale, he's running NBC decades later while everyone else has aged.

questions.questionText: What does Dr. Cox call J.D. instead of his real name on Scrubs?
options: Girls' names like Carol, Barbara, Sally
questions.funFact: John C. McGinley kept a running list of every female name he called J.D. He used over 100 different names across the series.

questions.questionText: What is the name of J.D. and Turk's bromantic relationship term on Scrubs?
questions.funFact: Zach Braff and Donald Faison are best friends in real life. Their on-screen chemistry was entirely genuine.

questions.questionText: What is Jake Peralta's rapid-fire catchphrase on Brooklyn Nine-Nine?
options: Cool cool cool cool cool no doubt no doubt
questions.funFact: Andy Samberg improvised the rapid 'cool cool cool' delivery. The writers started writing it into scripts after he kept doing it.

questions.questionText: What is Captain Holt's husband's name on Brooklyn Nine-Nine?
questions.funFact: Kevin is a classics professor. The deadpan romantic scenes between Holt and Kevin became fan favorites for their emotional sincerity.

questions.questionText: What event did Jake use the Halloween Heist to do in Brooklyn Nine-Nine Season 5?
questions.funFact: The Halloween Heist episodes became an annual tradition. Each one has increasingly elaborate and absurd heist plans.

questions.questionText: Which network saved Brooklyn Nine-Nine after Fox cancelled it?
questions.funFact: When Fox cancelled it, the fan outcry was so massive that NBC picked it up within 31 hours — one of the fastest rescues in TV history.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the big-box store manager who has worked there since 1989 in Superstore?
questions.funFact: Mark McKinney, who plays Glenn, is a former Kids in the Hall member. He brought improv skills that shaped Glenn's earnest awkwardness.

questions.questionText: What major real-world issue becomes a storyline for Mateo in Superstore?
options: He is falsely accused of theft
questions.funFact: Superstore was one of the first network sitcoms to feature an undocumented immigrant as a main character with a sustained storyline.

questions.questionText: What type of radio station is WNYX in NewsRadio?
questions.funFact: NewsRadio's time slot was changed 11 times during its run — one of the most schedule-shuffled shows in NBC history.

questions.questionText: Which comedian played Bill McNeal on NewsRadio before his tragic death?
questions.funFact: After Hartman's death in 1998, Jon Lovitz joined the cast out of real friendship with Hartman. The Season 5 premiere addressed the loss directly.

questions.questionText: Which podcast host played the station electrician Joe Garrelli on NewsRadio?
questions.funFact: Joe Rogan was a relatively unknown stand-up comedian during NewsRadio. Ray Romano was also considered for his role.

questions.questionText: Who plays the eccentric billionaire station owner Jimmy James on NewsRadio?
questions.funFact: Stephen Root later became famous as Milton Waddams in Office Space and Bill Dauterive on King of the Hill.

questions.questionText: What real person is Abbott Elementary School named after?
questions.funFact: Joyce Abbott was Brunson's teacher at Andrew Hamilton Elementary in Philly. Brunson's mother's 40-year teaching career inspired the show's concept.

questions.questionText: What went viral about Sheryl Lee Ralph's Emmy acceptance speech for Abbott Elementary?
options: She brought her students on stage
She forgot to thank the producers
questions.funFact: Ralph hadn't prepared a speech because she didn't expect to win. The spontaneous singing moment became one of the most celebrated Emmy moments ever.

questions.questionText: What show did Abbott Elementary do a crossover episode with in Season 4?
questions.funFact: Both shows are set in Philadelphia. The Always Sunny gang causing chaos at the school was a fan-requested crossover for years.

questions.questionText: What kind of company do the guys work at in Workaholics?
questions.funFact: The show's three stars — Blake, Adam, and Anders — actually lived together in the house used for filming during early seasons.

questions.questionText: What sketch comedy group did the Workaholics creators come from?
questions.funFact: Comedy Central discovered them through YouTube videos from Mail Order Comedy. Their lo-fi sketch style translated directly to the show.

questions.questionText: What is the Workaholics catchphrase meaning 'good' or 'cool'?
questions.funFact: The phrase became so associated with the show that fans would yell it at the actors in public, much to their amusement.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the soulless corporation in Better Off Ted?
questions.funFact: The fake Veridian Dynamics commercials that aired during episodes became so popular that some viewers thought they were real corporate ads.

questions.questionText: Who plays Ted's ruthless boss Veronica Palmer on Better Off Ted?
questions.funFact: Better Off Ted was critically adored but lasted only 2 seasons. It's considered one of TV's greatest overlooked comedies.

questions.questionText: What is Roy's go-to tech support response on The IT Crowd?
options: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
questions.funFact: The phrase became so famous that real IT departments made it into posters. It's essentially the universal IT helpdesk experience.

questions.questionText: Where is the IT department located in The IT Crowd?
questions.funFact: The dingy basement setting was a deliberate contrast to the sleek corporate floors above — a metaphor for how companies treat IT.

questions.questionText: What is Jen Barber's ironic qualification for heading the IT department in The IT Crowd?
questions.funFact: Three separate US remakes of The IT Crowd were attempted. All failed — including one with Joel McHale that never aired.

questions.questionText: Who is the goth character who lives in the server room on The IT Crowd?
questions.funFact: Richmond is played by Noel Fielding, who later became a host of The Great British Bake Off — a very different vibe.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the terrible sitcom Andy Millman creates in Extras?
questions.funFact: The show-within-a-show 'When the Whistle Blows' was a deliberate satire of lowest-common-denominator British sitcoms.

questions.questionText: What is the forced catchphrase from Andy's sitcom within Extras?
questions.funFact: Andy hates the catchphrase but the producer forces it into every episode — mirroring Gervais's real frustrations with network TV.

questions.questionText: Which celebrity tells Andy they only do movies for the money in Extras?
questions.funFact: Patrick Stewart's scene — pitching a screenplay where women's clothes fall off using his mind — is considered one of the funniest TV cameos ever.
